lag.evidence_source: [/page/9/Text/9] We find robust evidence for this process over time by observing a significant, effect of paternity leave used a year prior to a father's present job satisfaction, which then spills over one year later to father's life satisfaction; this in turn crosses over to the mother's family relationship satisfaction one year after.
